query: 2026-04-24 到 2026-04-29 这 6 天,全店退款率从约 7% 攀升到约 28%,根因和涉事 SKU 是什么?

ground_truth.factual_anchor: Case 3: 涉事 SKU P_C3 (2026-04-22 新上的网红同款针织开衫) / P_C3 退款率 44.8% / 色差占退款原因 ~89% / 全店逐日退款率 6.7% → 11.2% → 17.2% → 19.8% → 28.1% → 28.3% | SQL_A: SELECT date, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN is_refund THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS refund_pct FROM fact_order WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-04-24' AND '2026-04-29' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date; SQL_B: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_refund THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunds, ROUND(100.0*AVG(CASE WHEN is_refund THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS refund_pct, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN refund_reason='色差' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_refund THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS secha_pct FROM fact_order WHERE product_id='P_C3' GROUP BY product_id;

query: 对比 2026-04-02 和 2026-04-17 两天 GMV 异常的根因,有什么本质不同?

ground_truth.factual_anchor: 04-02 = 人货错配主导(UV 正常 ~3,221, 转化率断崖 4.2%→1.12%, P_C1 高端款错配主力客群);04-17 = 流量结构主导(UV 暴涨 ~9,800, 付费投流占比 65%, 该渠道转化仅 0.5%, 各渠道转化未恶化);两者 UV 方向相反 + 转化率分布机制不同 | SQL_A: SELECT (SELECT SUM(visitors) FROM fact_traffic WHERE date='2026-04-02') AS uv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order WHERE date='2026-04-02') AS orders, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(gmv), 2) FROM fact_order WHERE date='2026-04-02') AS gmv, (SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN product_id='P_C1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*), 2) FROM fact_order WHERE date='2026-04-02') AS pc1_share_pct; SQL_B: SELECT (SELECT SUM(visitors) FROM fact_traffic WHERE date='2026-04-17') AS uv_total, (SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN traffic_source='付费投流' THEN visitors ELSE 0 END)/SUM(visitors), 2) FROM fact_traffic WHERE date='2026-04-17') AS paid_uv_share_pct, (SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/9800.0, 2) FROM fact_order WHERE date='2026-04-17') AS overall_conv_pct;

rubric_notes: 跨 case 对比;LLM 必须同时识别两套根因机制,不能混为一谈(例如都归因为『转化率低』就 fail)。

query: 2026-04 月份和 2026-05 月份的总 GMV 分别是多少?差距多少?(注:2026-05 只有 17 天数据)

ground_truth.factual_anchor: 2026-04 月 GMV ¥1,048,682(30 天,4,838 单);2026-05 月 GMV ¥661,338(17 天,3,045 单);绝对值 04 月高 ¥387K,但日均 ¥34,956 vs ¥38,902,日均 05 月反而更高;理想答案会指出日均差异 + 提醒 05 月数据不完整 | SQL: SELECT SUBSTR(date::VARCHAR, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(gmv), 2) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fact_order WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-05-17' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

rubric_notes: 时间窗对比;LLM 必须意识到 05 月只有 17 天,直接做绝对值比较会误导,理想答案会日均化或注明天数。

query: 2026-03 月和 2026-04 月的全店退款率分别是多少?变化趋势怎么样?

query: 对比 2026-04 上半月(04-01 ~ 04-15)和下半月(04-16 ~ 04-30)的日均转化率与日均 GMV,异常天对结果有什么影响?

ground_truth.factual_anchor: H1_04(04-01~15, 15 天)日均转化率 4.07% / 日均 GMV ¥33,216;H2_04(04-16~30, 15 天)日均转化率 4.12% / 日均 GMV ¥36,696;两半月日均几乎持平(异常天被 14 个正常天稀释 < 0.2pp);H2 GMV 反而略高(case 2 高 UV 带来更多订单);异常天藏在均值后面 —— 理想答案会指出这点 | SQL: WITH daily AS (SELECT t.date, SUM(t.visitors) AS uv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order o WHERE o.date=t.date) AS orders, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.gmv), 0) FROM fact_order o WHERE o.date=t.date) AS gmv FROM fact_traffic t WHERE t.date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY t.date) SELECT CASE WHEN date <= DATE '2026-04-15' THEN 'H1_04' ELSE 'H2_04' END AS half, ROUND(AVG(100.0*orders/NULLIF(uv,0)), 2) AS daily_conv_pct, ROUND(AVG(gmv), 2) AS daily_gmv, COUNT(*) AS days FROM daily GROUP BY half ORDER BY half;

rubric_notes: 上半月含 case 1 (04-02),下半月含 case 2 (04-17) + case 3 部分天 (04-24~29);实测 snapshot 显示 H1/H2 日均转化率几乎持平(4.07% vs 4.12%),异常天被 14 个正常天稀释影响 < 0.2pp;但 H2 日均 GMV 反而高于 H1(case 2 高 UV 带来更多订单);理想答案要识别异常天的存在 + 解释为何「月度日均」对单日异常鲁棒 + 提示需要日粒度查看而非月度均值才能发现异常。仅返回均值不指异常 = fail。

query: 把 90 天分成 3 段(02-17~03-18 / 03-19~04-17 / 04-18~05-17),每段四个子品类(连衣裙/上衣/裤装/外套)的 GMV 占比有什么变化趋势?

ground_truth.factual_anchor: 连衣裙 GMV 份额逐段下降:P1 52.75% → P2 47.39% → P3 39.08%(春装窗口收缩);上衣份额逐段上升:P1 19.46% → P2 18.78% → P3 28.39%(向夏装过渡);外套份额 13.55% → 18.12% → 17.97%(P2 跃升后稳);裤装份额 14.24% → 15.72% → 14.56%(基本稳定);理想答案要识别『连衣裙下降 + 上衣上升』的季节迁移叙事 | SQL: WITH seg AS (SELECT o.date, p.sub_category, o.gmv, CASE WHEN o.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-17' AND DATE '2026-03-18' THEN 'P1' WHEN o.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-19' AND DATE '2026-04-17' THEN 'P2' WHEN o.date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-18' AND DATE '2026-05-17' THEN 'P3' END AS period FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-02-17' AND '2026-05-17') SELECT period, sub_category, ROUND(SUM(gmv), 2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0*SUM(gmv)/SUM(SUM(gmv)) OVER (PARTITION BY period), 2) AS share_pct FROM seg GROUP BY period, sub_category ORDER BY period, share_pct DESC;

rubric_notes: 时间×维度交叉;LLM 要识别 4 个子品类在 3 段时间的相对份额变化趋势(春装窗口期内连衣裙/上衣份额预期较高);仅返回总数不分段 = fail。
